5. Items Tab line items:- Line Item 1: Product ID `VELLYS SATELLITE STATION SKU1` ‘45157510101' , add Quantity 1, Plant BEV8, go to Sales Item Details add Price Details 'Z100' with  100% discount,  'ZSSP’ with  100,000 and Add Price 450,000 to  CE-Bndl Cont Price under Price Element.
